title: Separate nonrectangular T16 realization constraints
head: 0c6b973ccaa94e7048858c6071f22da6432b42e7
body:
PR2535 asks what colored-realization obstruction remains after every joint-width cut passes. This package gives a source-compatible counterexample in the actual capacity-16, 224-bin class 9: three active patterns `{7}`, `{5,5}`, `{4,5,7}` and flows `call 0={5}`, `call 1={5,5,7}`, `call 2={4,7}`. All 15,841 rectangle constraints and the earlier Hall/GR checks pass, yet two forced placements leave no legal call for C's width-7 helper. Moving one width-7 request from call 1 to call 0 gives a feasible assignment with the same patterns.

The new necessary inequality uses a nonrectangular set Z of call/width cells. Each pattern p contributes at most `min_U(sum(w outside U)p_w + |N_Z(U)|)`. The written counting proof holds for arbitrary legal class realizations; rectangle Z recovers PR2535's exact coefficient. The witness has load 5 and total bound 4. This is a stronger necessary condition; the predecessor already disclaims sufficiency.

The source-schema CLI evaluates a supplied cell set and emits coefficients for all 27 admissible source patterns, including absent candidate patterns. Its scope is one local class marginal and a supplied-cut check. Global demands, idle targets, realization sufficiency, automatic separation, optimizer performance and the complete 69,120-helper stage1 problem remain open. No paid-profile, supplier, packing-optimum or kappa gain is claimed.

Validation: native CPython 3.12.7 registered optimized primary and six Git-free/source/typed-receipt/CLI groups pass; CPython 3.14.5 primary passes. Exact checks cover all 15,841 rectangles, all 54 possible active placements (zero bad, one feasible retiming), 10,240 independent finite coefficient comparisons, 8,640 rectangle reductions and semantic controls showing why rectangular-hull or width-only bounds miss the obstruction. A separate AI reviewer independently checked all 27 coefficients by augmenting paths, all 15,841 rectangles, all 54 placements, source pins and the registered replay; no material issue was found. No full selected native cold replay, hosted CI, human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

Only `research/t16-nonrectangular-realization-cut/` is added. Canonical main was refreshed at selection and 14:48:04 UTC before submission, unchanged `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. PR2535 is pinned at `045c46ba090149d28ec6ee2a0e5e9651b8943978`; current PR2169 at `4452c98ce93b83e696fd285eeb024f6669c145c0`. The latter's model blobs are unchanged from the older head used by PR2535. Exact geometry/decoder/rectangle source reuse is credited and distinguished from the general proof. All dependency bytes authenticate before direct compilation; retained source and selected records are unchanged.

The selected-packing draw is refined to the named realization handoff. Overlap uses the complete 1,197-record Discussion cache through 12:29 UTC plus fresh 100/recent 30 open-PR REST reads and exact source comments; full Discussion refresh is quota-limited. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2535#issuecomment-6194327974). Credit Philippe Van Velzen/PR2169, PR2535 and their retained source lineage; standard neighborhood/matching counting is not claimed new. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Reproduce: `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/t16-nonrectangular-realization-cut`.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
